name: Opportunity with missing cycle history
query:
select B.name,B.custom_opportunity_cycle,c.state from `tabOpportunity` B left join (
 select  action_date,parent,state, rn  from (
select action_date,parent,state,   ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY parent ORDER BY action_date DESC) as rn from `tabOpportunity Cycle Item`) A
where A.rn=1   )  c on (c.parent=B.name ) where c.state != B.custom_opportunity_cycle
